proof_0457.moves: Given gamma <= gamma', show the subgroup {x | v x <= gamma} is contained in {x | v x <= gamma'}: take a member, its valuation is <= gamma <= gamma', so transitivity of <= in the value group closes it.

proof_0458.moves: Pure renaming: the norm identity for the star projection is exactly the previously-proved statement about the orthogonal projection onto a submodule, so the proof is a one-step delegation to that lemma.

proof_0459.moves: A continuous linear map on the reals is in particular a linear map, so the variance of its image of a real Gaussian is computed by the already-proved linear-map version of the formula.

proof_0460.moves: From 0 < -a conclude a < 0 by taking the forward direction of the equivalence 0 < -a iff a < 0 in an ordered additive group.

proof_0461.moves: uIcc a b is Icc (a inf b) (a sup b); since a inf b <= a and b <= a sup b, monotonicity of Icc in its endpoints gives the inclusion Icc a b subset uIcc a b.

proof_0462.moves: A complemented pair is in particular disjoint, and disjointness in a bounded lattice says exactly that the infimum is bottom.

proof_0463.moves: Specialization of maximality to sets: subset inclusion is the order on Set, so the general statement 'a maximal element equals anything above it' applies verbatim.

proof_0464.moves: Instantiate the localization form of the result at the localization map to the fraction ring, i.e. at the submonoid of non-zero-divisors, discharging the required containment of submonoids by reflexivity.

proof_0465.moves: 1 is a unit, and any unit is relatively prime to everything, so a is relatively prime to 1.

proof_0466.moves: An isometry is uniformly continuous, hence continuous, so the completion's induced ring hom agrees with the original on the image of the coercion by the general completion lemma.

proof_0467.moves: The coercion of a real to a complex number is Theta-equivalent to the real itself (norms agree), and little-o is invariant under Theta-equivalence on the left, so the two little-o statements are equivalent.

proof_0468.moves: Monotonicity of the congruence attached to a normal subgroup: use the characterization of when con N is below a congruence, applying its backwards direction to the given subgroup inclusion.

proof_0469.moves: In an order with no maximal element, no element is maximal, which discharges the side hypothesis of the conditional version of Ioo a (succ b) = Ioc a b.

proof_0470.moves: Order duality: the statement about eventually-const-le is exactly the already-proved eventually-le-const statement read in the order dual, with the dual order and topology instances transported.

proof_0471.moves: An additive equivalence is in particular a homomorphism of subtraction monoids, so the generic map_sub lemma applies directly; the proof is a one-line specialization.

proof_0472.moves: DirectSum.map is mapRange on the underlying dependent finitely-supported functions, so mapping the identity homomorphism is the identity by the corresponding DFinsupp lemma.

proof_0473.moves: The empty set is collinear, and any collinear set is coplanar; chaining the two gives coplanarity of the empty set.

proof_0474.moves: Surjectivity of homMk on morphisms of fibrant objects: given a morphism of the full subcategory, take its underlying morphism in the ambient category as the witness; the required equation holds by definition. The real content is exhibiting the witness, which no citation names.

proof_0475.moves: The curried-function form of the multiplicative support statement is the same statement as the already-proved mulSupport_curry, applied verbatim.

proof_0476.moves: The value of the power series X at an index is definitionally the indicator of that index being one, so the proof is pure definitional unfolding closed by rfl.

proof_0477.moves: The map sending a point to the singleton compact set is an isometry because the Hausdorff extended distance between two singletons equals the distance between the points.

proof_0478.moves: The map of an open partial homeomorphism maps source into target, its symm maps target into source, and the two are mutually inverse there; an inverse pair of maps between two sets is a bijection from one onto the other.

proof_0479.moves: Auto-generated obligation for transporting a colimit along an isomorphism of cocones: the descent morphism through the iso is unique, so rewrite the composite with the iso inverse using the cancellation law and apply uniqueness of cocone morphisms. Much of the term is rewriting scaffolding.

proof_0480.moves: Wrapper over the internal tree implementation: unpack the well-formedness hypothesis of the raw map, pass to the inner implementation, and apply the implementation-level lemma that any member key is at most the maximum key.
